vehicle.title: Deleted vehicles
vehicle.description: Every deleted vehicle is kept here with its reservations, documents and expenses, so it can be put back.
vehicle.purgeNote: The vehicle disappears with everything that belongs to it: reservations, documents and expenses. Files that belong to it are removed from disk.

customer.title: Deleted customers
customer.description: A deleted customer is kept here with its drivers and portal data, so it can be put back. The debtor number stays reserved while the customer is in here.
customer.purgeNote: The customer disappears with its drivers and portal data, and the debtor number becomes free again. Files that belong to it are removed from disk.

reservation.title: Deleted reservations
reservation.description: A deleted reservation is kept here. It can be restored as long as the vehicle is free for that period. Spare vehicles, transports and driver assignments that were closed are not reopened automatically.
reservation.purgeNote: The reservation disappears with its documents, damage checks and delivery tasks. Files that belong to it are removed from disk.

maintenance_block.title: Deleted maintenance
maintenance_block.description: A deleted maintenance appointment is kept here and can be restored. Spare vehicles that were closed are not reopened automatically.
maintenance_block.purgeNote: The maintenance entry disappears with its documents. Files that belong to it are removed from disk.

transport.title: Deleted transports
transport.description: A deleted transport is kept here. When it is restored, the matching spare vehicle is reopened if it is still free.
transport.purgeNote: The transport disappears from the recycle bin for good.

fine.title: Deleted fines
fine.description: Deleted fines are kept here with who deleted them and when, and can be restored.
fine.purgeNote: The fine disappears for good, together with its attached letter.

purge.confirmOne: “{{label}}” will be deleted from the recycle bin permanently.
purge.confirmCount_one: {{count}} {{noun}} will be deleted from the recycle bin permanently.
purge.confirmCount_other: {{count}} {{noun}} will be deleted from the recycle bin permanently.
purge.confirmAllCapped: All {{noun}} in this recycle bin will be deleted permanently (the list shows at most {{count}}).
purge.filesKept: A file that other data still uses is kept.

errors.NOT_FOUND: This record was no longer in the recycle bin.
errors.PURGE_FAILED: This record could not be deleted and is still in the recycle bin.
errors.FILE_REMOVAL_FAILED: The record was deleted, but one or more files could not be removed from disk.
